note: Reel Lab rules for clients on the healthcare compliance profile (crm_clients.blog_compliance_profile = 'healthcare'). Formula ids are from skills/ig-reel/hooks.json.

excluded_formulas.1: Cost Confession: a money-mistake story does not belong under a clinic's name
excluded_formulas.4: The Replacement: price-versus-price claims about treatment
excluded_formulas.5: Time Collapse: reads as a promise of faster results
excluded_formulas.13: Before And After: patient before/after results
excluded_formulas.17: Head To Head: comparing treatments or providers
excluded_formulas.25: Someone Else's Result: a patient's outcome used as a hook
excluded_formulas.26: The Superlative: best / fastest / only claims

rules: No promise or guarantee of a result, success rate or recovery time.
No patient stories, testimonials, outcomes or before/after unless the staff notes say the patient consented and give the exact wording.
No comparison with other doctors, clinics or treatments, and no best / only / number one claims.
Any statistic must come from the staff notes; otherwise write {{source + number}} and list it in placeholders.
Educational, not diagnostic: say what to ask the doctor about, never what the viewer has or should take.
The ask is to book a consultation, comment a keyword, or save the reel. Never 'DM us your reports'.
